question:
The section of the CPU that is responsible for performing mathematical operations:

[Allahabad High Court (CA) 18/12/2021 (Shift-II)]
options: Memory
Register Unit
Control Unit
ALU
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is ALU

Explanation:
The part of the CPU that is responsible for performing mathematical operations (such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) and logical operations (AND, OR, NOT) is called the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU). It is a fundamental component of the CPU that executes all types of calculations. The Control Unit decodes and executes instructions, Registers temporarily store data and instructions, and Memory is used for permanent data storage. Therefore, specifically for mathematical operations, the ALU is responsible.

Extra Facts:
The ALU interacts directly with the CPU's Control Unit and Registers. It operates on the binary number system. The other crucial part of the CPU is the Control Unit (CU), which controls and coordinates all computer operations. Registers are very high-speed memory locations used by the ALU for immediate data access. All these components of the CPU together are referred to as the processor core.

question:

[RAS/RTS (Pre) G.S., 2013]
options: Computer RAM
Computer microchip
Computer processor
All of the above
solution:

Explanation:
Celeron, Pentium and Core are formats of microprocessors developed by Intel Corporation. These all belong to the Central Processing Unit (CPU) family that executes the main operations and calculations of a computer. The Pentium series started in 1993, while the Core series offers more advanced multi-core processors. Celeron is a budget-friendly processor. These processors play a crucial role in determining computer performance, speed, and efficiency and are installed on the motherboard.

Extra Facts:
A microprocessor is an integrated circuit that handles all functions of the CPU. Besides Intel, AMD (Advanced Micro Devices) manufactures processors like Ryzen and Athlon. The clock speed (in GHz) of a processor indicates its speed. Multi-core processors (e.g., dual-core, quad-core) provide the ability to process multiple tasks simultaneously, improving multitasking and application performance.

question:
In Computers, Users are also known as

[UPPCL APS Exam-18.02.2018]
options: Humanware
Fireware
Hardware
Freeware
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Humanware

Explanation:
In computer systems, Humanware refers to the human beings who interact with the computer, such as users, operators, programmers, and system administrators. This term emphasizes the human element as a complement to the computer system's hardware (physical components) and software (programs and data). A computer system can only function effectively when there is a harmonious combination of these three components - hardware, software, and humanware. Firmware is software embedded in hardware, and freeware is a type of software available free of charge, neither of which directly refers to users.

Extra Facts:
The main components of a computer system include hardware (e.g., CPU, monitor, keyboard), software (e.g., operating system, applications), and humanware (users). Firmware is a special type of software permanently stored in a hardware device that controls its basic functions, such as the BIOS. Liveware is another informal term sometimes used for humanware. The utility of a computer ultimately depends on humanware, as humans provide instructions, input data, and interpret outputs.

question:
Which of the following components of the CPU maintains and regulates the flow of information across the processor?

[UPPCL Assistant Accountant 22-02-2022 (Shift-I)]
options: PC register
Control Unit (CU)
ALU
Accumulator
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Control Unit (CU)

Explanation:
The Control Unit (CU) of the CPU is the component that maintains and regulates the flow of information across the entire processor. It coordinates all hardware and software resources of the computer system. The Control Unit decodes instructions, sends signals for execution, and ensures that data reaches the correct location at the proper time. It regulates data flow between the ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) and memory. Without the Control Unit, different CPU components cannot work together, making the computer system inefficient.

Extra Facts:
The CPU has three main components: Control Unit (CU), Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), and Registers. The ALU performs arithmetic and logical operations, while registers provide temporary data storage. The Control Unit manages the instruction cycle - fetch, decode, execute, and store. It is a central part of computer architecture and affects execution speed and efficiency. In modern CPUs, the Control Unit is integral to microprocessor design.

CPU का कंट्रोल यूनिट (Control Unit) वह घटक है जो पूरे प्रोसेसर में सूचना के प्रवाह को बनाए रखता और नियंत्रित करता है। यह कंप्यूटर के सभी हार्डवेयर और सॉफ्टवेयर संसाधनों के बीच समन्वय स्थापित करता है। कंट्रोल यूनिट निर्देशों को डिकोड करता है, निष्पादन के लिए संकेत भेजता है, और यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि डेटा सही समय पर सही स्थान पर पहुँचे। यह ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) और मेमोरी के बीच डेटा प्रवाह को रेगुलेट करता है। बिना कंट्रोल यूनिट के, CPU के विभिन्न घटक एक साथ काम नहीं कर पाएंगे, जिससे कंप्यूटर सिस्टम अक्षम हो जाएगा।

CPU के तीन मुख्य घटक होते हैं: कंट्रोल यूनिट (CU), अर्थमैटिक लॉजिक यूनिट (ALU), और रजिस्टर्स। ALU अंकगणितीय और तार्किक संचालन करता है, जबकि रजिस्टर्स अस्थायी डेटा संग्रहण प्रदान करते हैं। कंट्रोल यूनिट निर्देश चक्र (Instruction Cycle) - फ़ेच, डिकोड, एक्ज़िक्यूट और स्टोर - को नियंत्रित करता है। यह कंप्यूटर आर्किटेक्चर का केंद्रीय भाग है और निष्पादन गति और दक्षता को प्रभावित करता है। आधुनिक CPUs में, कंट्रोल यूनिट माइक्रोप्रोसेसर डिज़ाइन का अभिन्न अंग है।

question:
Which of the following currently stores the programs and data executed by the CPU?

[UPPCL (TG-II) 24-01-2019 (Morning)]
options: Primary memory (Primary Memory)
Auxiliary memory (Auxiliary Memory)
Secondary memory (Secondary Memory)
Tertiary memory (Tertiary Memory)
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Primary memory (Primary Memory)

Explanation:
The programs and data that are currently being executed by the CPU are stored in Primary Memory. It is also known as main memory or RAM (Random Access Memory). This memory is volatile, meaning that the data stored in it is lost when the power is turned off. Primary memory has a very high access speed to keep up with the CPU's pace, allowing the processor to quickly access instructions and data. On the other hand, secondary or auxiliary memory (like HDD, SSD) is used for permanent storage of data and programs, but the CPU cannot directly execute them until they are loaded into the primary memory.

Extra Facts:
In the computer memory hierarchy, Primary Memory is at the top and includes RAM and ROM (Read Only Memory). RAM is read-write memory while ROM is read-only and stores critical data like firmware. Cache Memory is even faster than primary memory and is located inside or very close to the CPU. Secondary memory (like Hard Disk) is non-volatile and stores data permanently, but its access speed is slower than primary memory. Memory management is a crucial function of the operating system.

The action of writing new data in the register erases the first content of the register. Registers are high-speed memory locations inside the CPU that temporarily store data and instructions. This is a fundamental principle of computer architecture where register write operations are destructive, while read operations are non-destructive. This characteristic ensures processing efficiency in computers.

Extra Facts:
Registers are among the most critical components of a computer processor that play a vital role in instruction execution. There are different types of registers such as Accumulator, Program Counter, Instruction Register, and Memory Address Register. question:
With respect to the computer system, the term 'cache' means:

[UPPCL Assistant Accountant 31-07-2023 Shift-I]
options: a small but faster memory placed between the CPU and the main memory to reduce the memory access time
a way of connecting multiple functional units to the internal bus
a group of physical lines meant to carry information
a memory trash can
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is a small but faster memory placed between the CPU and the main memory to reduce the memory access time

Explanation:
In computer systems, cache memory is a high-speed memory located between the CPU and main memory (RAM). Its primary purpose is to reduce memory access time and improve system performance. Cache operates on the principle of locality of reference, which states that the CPU frequently accesses the same data and instructions. Cache memory is built using Static RAM (SRAM) which is faster than Dynamic RAM (DRAM). It is a crucial component of the memory hierarchy and comes in levels like L1, L2, L3.

Extra Facts:
Cache memory plays a vital role in computer architecture. A cache hit occurs when the CPU finds required data in cache, while a cache miss happens when data must be fetched from main memory. Despite its small size, cache significantly improves system speed. Modern processors have built-in cache memory. Without cache memory, the speed of modern computer systems would be considerably reduced.

question:
For which of the following is an interrupt mechanism NOT required?

[NVS PGT 19.09.2019 (Shift-I)]
options: When programs request a system call to be performed by the operating system
To give the user better control over the computer
To allow the processes to manage shared data
To handle mismatch between CPU and device speeds
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is To allow the processes to manage shared data

Explanation:
The interrupt mechanism is a hardware-software interface that enables the CPU to handle immediate attention-requiring events. While interrupt mechanism is essential for handling system calls, providing user control, and managing CPU-device speed mismatches (as these situations demand immediate response), shared data management among processes is primarily handled through synchronization mechanisms like semaphores, mutexes, and monitors. These mechanisms establish coordination between processes without requiring interrupt handling. The operating system can ensure safe management of shared data through these synchronization tools independently of the interrupt mechanism.

Extra Facts:
The interrupt mechanism is a fundamental component of operating systems that enables I/O device management, error handling, and multitasking. There are two types of interrupts: hardware interrupts (generated by external devices) and software interrupts (generated by programs). Interrupt handlers are special routines that respond to interrupts. Modern operating systems like Windows and Linux use interrupt mechanisms to improve system efficiency and response time. The interrupt vector table stores addresses of interrupt service routines for quick access during interrupt processing.

question:
What does MIPS mean in computer terminology?

[RRB NTPC, (Shift -2) Online, 18.04.2016]
options: Marginal Input Storage
Million Instructions Per Second
Micro Information Processing Storage
Memory Image Processing State
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Million Instructions Per Second

Explanation:
MIPS stands for 'Million Instructions Per Second', which is a unit for measuring the performance of a computer's CPU (Central Processing Unit). It indicates the speed of a processor by showing how many millions of instructions it can execute in one second. It is a crucial metric for a computer's overall throughput and is useful in hardware comparisons. However, it is not considered an entirely accurate measure for modern processors because different types of instructions take varying amounts of time to execute. Despite this, it remains a fundamental concept in computer architecture and processor design.

Extra Facts:
Besides MIPS, other metrics used to measure computer performance include FLOPS (Floating Point Operations Per Second) and CPI (Clock Cycles Per Instruction). FLOPS is particularly important for measuring the performance of scientific calculations and supercomputers. Other factors that influence a computer's speed include the size of the cache memory, bus speed, and the number of cores. Modern multi-core processors deliver higher MIPS values because they enable parallel processing.

Explanation:
MIPS का पूरा नाम 'Million Instructions Per Second' है, जो कंप्यूटर के CPU (Central Processing Unit) के प्रदर्शन को मापने की एक इकाई है। यह एक प्रोसेसर की गति को दर्शाता है कि वह एक सेकंड में कितने लाख (मिलियन) निर्देशों को निष्पादित कर सकता है। यह कंप्यूटर की संपूर्ण क्षमता (Throughput) का एक महत्वपूर्ण मापदंड है और हार्डवेयर तुलना में उपयोगी होता है। हालाँकि, यह आधुनिक प्रोसेसरों के लिए एकदम सटीक माप नहीं माना जाता, क्योंकि विभिन्न प्रकार के निर्देशों को निष्पादित करने में अलग-अलग समय लगता है। फिर भी, यह कंप्यूटर आर्किटेक्चर और प्रोसेसर डिजाइन में एक मौलिक अवधारणा बनी हुई है।

Extra Facts:
MIPS के अलावा, कंप्यूटर प्रदर्शन मापने के लिए FLOPS (Floating Point Operations Per Second) और CPI (Clock Cycles Per Instruction) जैसे मैट्रिक्स भी उपयोग किए जाते हैं। FLOPS वैज्ञानिक गणनाओं और सुपरकंप्यूटरों के प्रदर्शन को मापने के लिए विशेष रूप से महत्वपूर्ण है। कंप्यूटर की गति को प्रभावित करने वाले अन्य कारकों में कैश मेमोरी (Cache Memory) का आकार, बस की गति (Bus Speed), और कोर की संख्या (Number of Cores) शामिल हैं। मल्टी-कोर प्रोसेसर आजकल अधिक MIPS मान प्रदान करते हैं क्योंकि वे समानांतर प्रसंस्करण (Parallel Processing) को सक्षम करते हैं।

question:
All the arithmetic and logical operations in a computer are done by ............

[UPSSSC ETO 19.01.2025, SSC JE Civil - 27/01/2018 (Shift-II)]
options: ALU
CU
Register
No option is correct.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is ALU

Explanation:
The ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) is a fundamental component of the computer's CPU (Central Processing Unit) that performs all arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) and logical operations (AND, OR, NOT, XOR). It receives instructions from the Control Unit (CU) and operates on data stored in registers. The ALU plays a crucial role in determining the processing speed and capability of a computer. The Control Unit (CU) only manages the flow of instructions, while registers are used for temporary data storage.

Extra Facts:
The CPU consists of three main components: ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), CU (Control Unit), and registers. In the Von Neumann architecture, the ALU holds central importance. Modern microprocessors may contain multiple ALUs enabling parallel processing. The Floating Point Unit (FPU) is a specialized ALU for complex mathematical calculations. In the computer's execution cycle, the ALU becomes active during the 'execute' phase of the fetch-decode-execute cycle.

A computer can switch from document editing to playing a game, and then to performing calculations or programming, all with consistent performance. This is made possible by the combination of hardware and software. The other options are not correct in this context: Accuracy relates to the absence of errors, Diligence refers to working continuously without fatigue, and Reliability is about delivering correct results consistently over time.

Extra Facts:
Characteristics of a Computer is an important topic for exams. Speed enables a computer to perform calculations at a very fast rate. Accuracy ensures that the computer provides error-free results based on the given input and program. Storage Capacity is the ability to hold vast amounts of data, which is the foundation of database management. Automation is the capability to perform tasks automatically, achieved through programming. All these features combined make the computer a powerful tool in modern technology.

Extra Facts:

question:
The program used to work on a computer is called-

[Jharkhand Forest Guard - 2015]
options: software
mouse
keyboard
hardware
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is software

Explanation:
The program used to work on a computer is called software. Software is a set of instructions and data that tells a computer how to perform specific tasks. It is the opposite of hardware (physical devices). There are two main types of software: System Software (like Operating Systems) that operates the computer hardware, and Application Software (like word processors, web browsers) that helps users perform specific tasks. Mouse and keyboard are input devices, which fall under the hardware category, not programs.

Extra Facts:
Software is written in programming languages like C, C++, Java, Python, etc. An Operating System (like Windows, Linux, macOS) is a type of system software that acts as an interface between the user and computer hardware. Without software, computer hardware is useless, as it is the software that instructs the hardware on what to do. The Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) includes phases like requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, and maintenance.

solution:

In computers, hardware refers to the physical components that can be touched and seen. A CD ROM is a type of optical storage device, making it a physical hardware component. question:
The CPU and RAM (Random Access Memory) are located on the:

[MPPCS (J) 2012]
options: Expansion Board
Motherboard
Storage device
Output device
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Motherboard

Explanation:
Both the CPU and RAM are located on the motherboard. The motherboard is the main circuit board of a computer that connects all hardware components together. The CPU is installed in the CPU socket on the motherboard, while RAM is placed in RAM slots. The motherboard provides buses for data transfer between these components. Expansion boards are for additional functionality, storage devices are for data storage, and output devices display results - none of these are the primary locations for CPU and RAM.

Extra Facts:
The motherboard is also called the mainboard or system board. It controls communication between components using northbridge and southbridge chipsets. Modern motherboards feature PCI-Express slots, SATA connectors, and BIOS/UEFI chips. The motherboard's form factor (like ATX, Micro-ATX) determines the computer case size. It functions as the computer system's central nervous system.

question:
With reference to "Instructions", which of the following options is incorrect?

[UPPCL TG-2 17/11/2023 (Shift-I)]
options: The code required to direct the computer to perform a discrete action
Given by a computer program to a computer processor. An order has been placed
A collection of software application specially designed to execute specific tasks
Step which is a single operation of the processor and is to be executed by the processor
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Option 3 - A collection of software application specially designed to execute specific tasks

Explanation:
Instructions in computer architecture refer to machine language codes that command the processor to perform specific operations. These are basic commands executed directly by the CPU, such as arithmetic operations, data transfers, or control flow instructions. Option 3 is incorrect because it describes a collection of software applications, whereas instructions are the fundamental building blocks of a program. In programming, a group of instructions forms machine code that operates at the hardware level, not high-level software like application software.

Extra Facts:
Computer instructions consist of an operation code (Opcode) and operands. The Instruction Set Architecture (ISA) is the set of instructions supported by a processor, such as x86 or ARM. In assembly language, instructions are written in human-readable form, which an assembler converts into machine code. CISC and RISC are two major instruction set architectures, where CISC supports complex instructions, while RISC focuses on simple and fast instructions.

निर्देश (Instructions) कंप्यूटर आर्किटेक्चर में मशीनी भाषा के कोड होते हैं जो प्रोसेसर को विशिष्ट ऑपरेशन करने का आदेश देते हैं। ये CPU द्वारा सीधे एक्जीक्यूट किए जाने वाले बेसिक कमांड्स हैं, जैसे अंकगणितीय ऑपरेशन, डेटा ट्रांसफर, या नियंत्रण प्रवाह संबंधी निर्देश। विकल्प 3 गलत है क्योंकि यह सॉफ्टवेयर एप्लीकेशन के कलेक्शन का वर्णन करता है, जबकि निर्देश प्रोग्राम का मौलिक बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक हैं। प्रोग्रामिंग में, निर्देशों का समूह मशीन कोड बनाता है, जो हार्डवेयर लेवल पर कार्य करता है, न कि एप्लीकेशन सॉफ्टवेयर जैसे उच्च-स्तरीय सॉफ्टवेयर का।

Extra Facts:
कंप्यूटर निर्देश ऑपरेशन कोड (Opcode) और ऑपरेंड से मिलकर बनते हैं। निर्देश सेट आर्किटेक्चर (ISA) प्रोसेसर द्वारा समर्थित निर्देशों का सेट है, जैसे x86 या ARM। असेम्बली भाषा में, निर्देशों को मनुष्य-पठनीय फॉर्म में लिखा जाता है, जिसे असेम्बलर मशीनी कोड में परिवर्तित करता है। CISC और RISC दो प्रमुख निर्देश सेट आर्किटेक्चर हैं, जहाँ CISC जटिल निर्देशों का समर्थन करता है, जबकि RISC सरल और तेज़ निर्देशों पर केंद्रित है।

question:

[RRB NTPC 10.01.2021 (Shift-I) Stage Ist]
options: VGA monitor port
USB port
Parallel port
PS/2 ports
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is USB port

It provides plug-and-play capability, allowing devices to be connected or disconnected while the computer is running. USB has replaced older ports like serial and parallel ports because it offers high speed, reliability, and universal compatibility. Its various versions (USB 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, etc.) increase data transfer speeds, which is crucial in modern computing.

Extra Facts:
USB technology was developed in 1996 by a group of companies including Intel, Microsoft, and IBM. USB-C, the latest version, provides a reversible connector and advanced features like power delivery and video output. USB devices use a host-controller architecture to communicate with the computer, making data transfer efficient. This technology covers the physical and data link layers of the OSI model.

Which of the following is used to connect different external devices?

[Allahabad High Court (ARO) 19/12/2021 (Shift-II)]
options: Address bus
Data bus
Control bus
External bus
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is External bus

Explanation:
An external bus is a computer bus used to connect the CPU and motherboard with various external devices such as printers, keyboards, mice, external hard drives, etc. It provides a communication pathway between the computer system and the external world. Other options like address bus (for memory location transfer), data bus (for data transfer), and control bus (for control signals) are used for internal system component communication. A computer bus is a communication system for transmitting data, addresses, and control signals. Bus architecture significantly impacts computer performance. PCI, PCI Express, and SATA are examples of internal buses, while USB, FireWire, and Ethernet are major standards for external buses. Plug and Play technology is made possible through external buses, enabling automatic device configuration and enhancing user convenience in connecting peripherals.

question:
An integrated circuit is commonly known as :

[RRB NTPC 30.01.2021 (Shift-I) Stage Ist]
options: chip
resistor
transistor
plate
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is chip

Explanation:
An Integrated Circuit (IC) is commonly known as a chip or microchip. It is a small electronic device made from a semiconductor material (usually silicon) on which thousands to billions of components like transistors, resistors, and capacitors are fabricated. It is a prime example of miniaturization technology that has enabled modern computing. Chips form the core foundation of a computer's CPU, memory, and other motherboard components. The other options, like resistor and transistor, are individual components that exist inside a chip, while a plate is a generic term and is not correct in this context.

Extra Facts:
The invention of the integrated circuit is credited to Jack Kilby (Texas Instruments) and Robert Noyce (Fairchild Semiconductor), who independently developed it in 1958-1959. ICs are classified based on their scale of integration: SSI (Small-Scale Integration), MSI (Medium-Scale Integration), LSI (Large-Scale Integration), and VLSI (Very Large-Scale Integration). Most modern microprocessors are based on VLSI technology. This technology has historically followed Moore's Law, which observed that the number of transistors on a chip roughly doubles every two years.

एकीकृत परिपथ (Integrated Circuit) को आमतौर पर चिप या माइक्रोचिप के नाम से जाना जाता है। यह एक सेमीकंडक्टर पदार्थ (आमतौर पर सिलिकॉन) का बना छोटा इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरण है जिस पर हजारों से लेकर करोड़ों ट्रांजिस्टर, रेजिस्टर और कैपेसिटर जैसे घटक निर्मित होते हैं। यह मिनिएचराइजेशन तकनीक का एक उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण है, जिसने आधुनिक कंप्यूटिंग को संभव बनाया है। चिप्स कंप्यूटर के CPU, मेमोरी और अन्य मदरबोर्ड घटकों का मूल आधार हैं। अन्य विकल्प जैसे प्रतिरोधक और ट्रांजिस्टर चिप के अंदर मौजूद व्यक्तिगत घटक हैं, जबकि प्लेट एक सामान्य शब्द है और इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है।

Extra Facts:
एकीकृत परिपथ के आविष्कार का श्रेय जैक किल्बी (Texas Instruments) और रॉबर्ट नॉयस (Fairchild Semiconductor) को जाता है, जिन्होंने 1958-1959 में स्वतंत्र रूप से इसकी खोज की। ICs को उनकी एकीकरण की डिग्री के आधार पर वर्गीकृत किया जाता है: SSI (Small-Scale Integration), MSI (Medium-Scale Integration), LSI (Large-Scale Integration), और VLSI (Very Large-Scale Integration)। आज के अधिकांश माइक्रोप्रोसेसर VLSI तकनीक पर आधारित हैं। यह तकनीक मूर के नियम का पालन करती आई है, जिसमें प्रति चिप ट्रांजिस्टर की संख्या लगभग हर दो साल में दोगुनी हो जाती है।

question:
Which part of the computer is called the nerve system?

[RRB NTPC, (Shift -2) Online, 18.04.2016]
options: Software
Hardware
Control unit
Programs
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Control unit

Explanation:
The Control Unit is called the nerve system of the computer because it is a key component of the Central Processing Unit (CPU). It controls and coordinates all operations of the computer, similar to how the nervous system in the human body manages communication and control between various organs. The Control Unit directs the flow of data between input/output devices, memory, and the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU). It ensures that instructions are fetched, decoded, and executed properly, enabling the computer to function correctly.

Extra Facts:
The CPU is often referred to as the brain of the computer and consists of three main parts: Control Unit, ALU, and Registers. The Control Unit operates by sending and receiving signals among hardware components. It manages the machine cycle, which includes steps like fetch, decode, execute, and store. Analogous to the nervous system, it synchronizes the entire operation of the computer, without which the computer would remain inactive.

CPU को कंप्यूटर का दिमाग कहा जाता है, और इसमें तीन मुख्य भाग होते हैं: कंट्रोल यूनिट, ALU और रजिस्टर। कंट्रोल यूनिट हार्डवेयर कंपोनेंट्स के बीच सिग्नल भेजकर और प्राप्त करके काम करती है। यह मशीन साइकिल को मैनेज करती है, जिसमें फेच, डिकोड, एक्जिक्यूट और स्टोर के स्टेप्स शामिल होते हैं। नर्व सिस्टम की तुलना में, यह कंप्यूटर के पूरे ऑपरेशन को सिंक्रोनाइज़ रखती है, जिसके बिना कंप्यूटर निष्क्रिय रहता है।

question:
The diligence characteristic of a computer refers to its ability to perform millions of tasks or calculations with the same ........... and accuracy.

[UPPCL TG]
options: Speed
willingness
Consistency
Capacity
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Consistency

Explanation:
The diligence characteristic of a computer refers to its tireless working capability. It is the quality that enables a computer to perform millions of tasks or calculations with the same consistency and accuracy. Unlike humans, who may make errors due to fatigue or boredom, a computer maintains a consistent level of performance throughout its operation. This consistency is what makes it a reliable machine, regardless of how repetitive or complex the task is. This fundamental trait is crucial in fields like banking, scientific research, and large-scale data processing, where uniform results are paramount.

Extra Facts:
Other key characteristics of a computer include speed, accuracy, reliability, and storage capacity. Speed refers to the computer's ability to process data at an incredibly fast rate. Accuracy means that a computer will not make mistakes unless provided with incorrect instructions or data. Reliability is the ability to work continuously for long periods without failure. These core attributes, combined with diligence, make the computer an indispensable and powerful tool in the modern world.

options: They are types of processors
They are names of apps
They are brands of storage devices
They are brands of memories
solution:

Explanation:
Snapdragon, Atom, Tegra, Helio and Exynos are all types of processors, specifically known as System-on-Chip (SoC) designs. These are primarily used in mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets. Snapdragon is developed by Qualcomm, Atom by Intel, Tegra by NVIDIA, Helio by MediaTek, and Exynos by Samsung. These processors integrate CPU, GPU, memory controller and other components into a single chip, optimizing device performance while reducing power consumption.

Extra Facts:
A System-on-Chip (SoC) is an integrated circuit that combines all components of a computer or electronic system onto a single chip. SoCs typically include CPU, GPU, memory, storage controllers and communication interfaces. In mobile processor design, ARM architecture is dominant, providing high performance with low power consumption. Modern SoCs also support advanced features like AI processing and 5G connectivity, making them essential for contemporary smart devices.

question:

[BPSC TRE 2.0 Exam-2023 (11-12)]
options: microcontroller
microprocessor
assembler
More than one of the above
None of the above
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is microcontroller

Explanation:
A microcontroller is an integrated circuit (IC) that contains a CPU, memory (RAM/ROM), and input/output peripherals on a single chip. It is widely used in embedded systems, such as in automobiles, home appliances, and industrial control systems. A microprocessor is only the CPU and requires external components to function. An assembler is a software tool that converts assembly language into machine code. Therefore, since a complete computer on a single chip is described, microcontroller is the correct answer.

Extra Facts:
Microcontrollers are designed for low power consumption and cost-effectiveness. They include features like analog-to-digital converters (ADC), timers, and communication interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C. Popular development boards like Arduino and Raspberry Pi are based on microcontrollers. Key microcontroller architectures include 8051, PIC, AVR, and ARM. They are often used with real-time operating systems (RTOS) to ensure reliability in time-critical applications.

question:
The ALU and control unit together are usually referred to as

[UPPCL (Office Assistant III) 23-09-2018]
options: Input unit
Processor
Storage unit
Output unit
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Processor

Explanation:
The ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) and Control Unit together are commonly referred to as the Processor or Central Processing Unit (CPU). The ALU performs all arithmetic and logical operations, while the Control Unit manages and coordinates all computer operations. These two units combined form the 'brain' of the computer. Input Unit and Output Unit are responsible for input-output of data, while Storage Unit stores data. Therefore, the combination of ALU and Control Unit performs the actual processing tasks.

Extra Facts:
The CPU is also called a microprocessor and is the most critical component of a computer. The CPU has three main components: ALU, Control Unit, and Registers. The ALU performs mathematical calculations (addition, subtraction) and logical operations (AND, OR, NOT). The Control Unit decodes instructions and directs all other components to operate in a timely manner. Registers temporarily store data and instructions.
